question: zadok-3 is recorded with more than one father: ahitub-3, meraioth-2.
note: 1CH 6:12 explicitly says Ahitub begot Zadok (הוֹלִיד), while 1CH 9:11 and NEH 11:11 place Meraioth between them. The supplied texts do not determine whether this reflects genealogical compression or differing traditions, so they do not justify changing either recorded line.
